matches.rationale: GT1 concerns an unsupported absolute claim in the abstract about 'completely eliminating' artifacts, contradicted by Table 1 FID scores. No finding addresses this claim-evidence mismatch in the abstract.

GT2 identifies specific data integrity issues in Table 1: Overall FID formatting inconsistencies and marginal Transition FID differences contradicting claimed improvements. No finding addresses these specific table formatting or numerical interpretation issues.

GT3 concerns the logical inconsistency where r=1 eliminates SPDM contribution (P⁰_c) in Equation 2, contradicting claims about progressive semantic enrichment. Finding 1 discusses a different parameter (α) inconsistency, not the r=1 logic issue.
Both GT4 and Finding 7 identify the undisclosed asymmetric training setup where ACT-PAE was pre-trained on HumanML3D while baselines used only BABEL-TEACH, creating an unfair comparison advantage.
Both GT5 and Finding 2 identify fabricated citations [41] and [42] in the Related Work section that do not exist in the reference list (which ends at [40]).
Both GT6 and Finding 3 identify the dimensional inconsistency between the claimed Q=512 phase latent size and the 4-parameter description [F, A, B, S], creating an architectural specification error.

GT7 concerns overstated claims about 'superior performance' in Table 2 when results show only marginal improvements marked with asterisks. No finding addresses this specific claim-evidence mismatch in Table 2.
GT8 concerns the ethical omission of BABEL-TEACH dataset limitations (demographic biases, label noise) in Section 4.1.1. No finding addresses these missing dataset limitation disclosures.
GT9 concerns inappropriate promotional language ('revolutionary', 'groundbreaking') in the Introduction. No finding addresses rhetorical tone or presentation style issues.
GT10 concerns the selective omission of R-precision metric in Section 4.1.2 despite it being used in baseline papers. No finding addresses this specific metric exclusion issue.

GT11 identifies dimensional/mathematical inconsistency in Equation 1 regarding T and S. Finding 4 identifies the sign inconsistency (F·T+S vs F·(T-S)), and Finding 5 identifies the contradictory range specifications for T, both addressing mathematical errors in the same equation.
GT12 concerns asymmetric inference steps (100 vs 50) between proposed method and baselines in Appendix A.4. No finding addresses this specific evaluation protocol asymmetry.

GT13 concerns overstated claims about 'superior performance across all settings' in Table 3 when some metrics show only marginal improvements. No finding addresses this specific claim-evidence mismatch in Table 3.
GT14 concerns mischaracterization of DeepPhase's PAE as an 'extension' when it was a primary novel contribution. No finding addresses this specific misrepresentation of prior work's contributions.

GT15 concerns the abstract's incorrect claim that phase parameters are 'kept fixed' during inbetweening, contradicting the actual method in Section 3.2.2. No finding addresses this abstract-method conceptual misalignment.
